Technical Proposal
Case Management & Referral Tracking Platform for the Ministry of Social Development
Submitted in response to MSD/IT/2023-009
Executive Summary
We are pleased to submit this proposal for the design, development, and deployment of a unified case
management and referral tracking platform for the Ministry of Social Development (MSD), replacing a
fragmented set of spreadsheet-based tools used across 9 regional offices. Our team combines deep
public-sector delivery experience with proven expertise in secure, offline-capable field data systems.
Understanding of the Requirements
MSD required a web-based case management system with a companion mobile app for field caseworkers,
integration with the national social registry API, migration of over 40,000 existing case records, and a
12-month post-launch support period.
Proposed Approach & Methodology
We proposed a phased Agile delivery across four stages: discovery and requirements validation,
architecture and data model design, iterative development with bi-weekly stakeholder demos, and a
structured UAT and training rollout across all 9 regional offices.
Outcome
The project was delivered on schedule over 8 months, followed by a 12-month support engagement. The
platform has processed over 60,000 case records since go-live, with a reported 35% reduction in average
case processing time across regional offices.
